title: sse-streaming-partial-json-delimiter-token-ordering-fix
author: Jordan Liu
description: Fix race in SSE streaming framing that could emit partial-JSON delimiters and token/event frames out of order. Root cause was a timing gap between the framing buffer flush and the token-event emitter when tool/function call meta events interleaved with token streams: delimiters could be emitted after the first token of the next object, producing truncated or invalid JSON for clients parsing partial objects. This PR centralizes framing state into a FramingState machine, enforces strict ordering (delimiter/meta events before token payloads), and makes the OpenAI-compat layer preserve event order for compatibility consumers. Changes include new unit and integration tests that reproduce the incident, a small fuzzer added to CI for SSE boundary cases, and minor docs about ordering guarantees. Checklist: [x] reproduce failure in unit tests, [x] add deterministic regression tests, [x] add CI fuzz job, [x] update OpenAI compat layer, [x] update changelog. Linked Linear: ENG-4182 (streaming stability), ENG-4201 (openai-compat ordering).
